summary: Software Engineer with over 4 years of experience in Backend development, specialized in creating APIs and microservices using Node.js, TypeScript, and modern architectures such as BFF. I integrate Artificial Intelligence tools (Claude Code, Gemini) into the development lifecycle to optimize code refactoring, accelerate the creation of automated tests, and improve team efficiency. Skilled in working with PHP frameworks like Laravel and Lumen, as well as maintaining legacy systems. Experienced in multi-stack environments (React, Docker, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQL Server) and Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban). Oriented towards delivering clean, scalable code and continuous improvement of the systems I participate in.

experience.title: Systems Analyst / Developer
responsibilities: Led the technical requirement gathering process and quality control in the software lifecycle.
Developed new systems integrated into the institutional ERP using Laravel 10.
Maintained legacy systems built with pure PHP 7.4 and the Ext JS 6 framework.
Built independent systems with modern architecture using Lumen for APIs and React for the frontend.
Managed databases using SQL Server and Docker containers across environments.
Implemented automated tests (unit and integration) using PHPUnit, supported by generative AI tools (Claude Code, Gemini) to maximize code coverage and ensure robustness in key classes and components.

Assisted in the development of complex modules and migration of legacy systems to modern architectures, applying responsible vibe coding with AI support to accelerate technical decision-making and reduce risks.
